g.data-description: guide - green steady: Junos loaded; blinking: booting; off: powered off or halted
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: guide - lit on alarm; unlit: no alarm or device halted
g.title: led-alm

g.data-description: guide - SPD (speed), read by blink rate: one blink per second 10 Mbps, two 100 Mbps, three 1000 Mbps. A MODE lamp for the port LEDs, not a port lamp
g.title: led-spd

g.data-description: guide - DX (duplex mode): on steadily full-duplex, off half-duplex
g.title: led-dx

g.data-description: guide - EN (administrative status): on steadily administratively enabled, off administratively disabled
g.title: led-en

g.data-description: photo - the white beacon at the right end of the lamp matrix, seated in the 3.2 mm opening the front panel measurement recorded. THE GUIDE DOES NOT LIST IT: its chassis-LED table runs SYS, ALM, MST and PH and stops, so the colour and the position are the photograph and the behaviour is the name. common/led-indicator is used rather than the led-dot the other seven carry because a beacon is the larger lamp - 4.0 mm against 2.0 - which is also why it has an opening of its own and they do not
g.title: led-beacon
